generalSemanticCondition.condition: At one revision bind a maintainer default declaration, root directory and implementation relay, platform/prerequisite chain and explicit scope/exclusions. Readiness/resolution/test correctness remain distinct future execution observations. Do not require full imported dependency correctness or infer missing facts from command plausibility.

sourceAvailability.locatorScope: Existing owning E1 packets and bounded locator inspection by e1_establishment; no full Compose archive or recursive package-tree locator identified there. This is not universal host-file absence.

prerequisites: Linux host prerequisites declared by BUILDING.md: Docker 20.10 or later, Make, and host Go satisfying root go.mod minimum 1.26.10. This host declaration is distinct from the container builder toolchain.

Provide functioning Docker/Buildx BuildKit infrastructure supporting bake and the declared bind/cache mounts. Makefile defaults BUILDX_CMD to docker buildx; no minimum Buildx version is documented in retained sources.

Allow the declared builder image, apk package, Go module and gotestsum v1.13.0 acquisition, or suitable existing images/caches. Default in-image Go is 1.26.10 from Dockerfile ARG, independently of host Go. The builder installs gcc/musl-dev and enables CGO for the race detector.
Use the unchanged default Make/Bake/Dockerfile configuration; overrides of BUILDX_CMD, GO_VERSION, BUILD_TAGS, GOTESTSUM_VERSION and DESTDIR require a new applicability assessment.
Coverage is the maintainer default main Go module unit target, excluding e2e package paths; relay/ is a separate module/target. This is not every module or e2e lane.
